Ravindra does a Dhoni and he finishes it off in style! 
Rachin Ravindra: Mumbai made it really difficult for us, they changed the pace nicely in 
the middle. Chokes us in the middle over and made it difficult for us. The Chepauk 
wicket is definitely tricky at times, you don't know what to expect. Rutu is amazing, 
struck at 200 without really trying, great batsmanship. It (the bump on the head he 
suffered in Pakistan) has been alright, hopefully it doesn't happen again. The pitch was 
definitely holding a fraction, wasn't turning a mile but their lengths made it difficult of 
runs. 
Suryakumar Yadav: We were actually 15-20 runs short but the fight the boys showed 
was commendable. Amazing (debut from Vignesh Puthur). MI is known for that, 
scouring youngsters 10 months a year and they've done that, he has a bright future 
ahead. I kept his one over in the end in my pocket in case the game went far but it was a 
no-brainer in the end. There was no dew but it was a pretty sticky, Ruturaj batted very 
well in the second innings. 
11.20pm Time flies and all that but MI's batting made it look like it's still IPL 2024 going 
on. They were without their regular captain Hardik Pandya today, Bumrah is still not 
available and they'll hope they get things back on track soon. Their next game is also on 
the road, against GT in Ahmedabad before they head home whereas CSK take on RCB 
next at home on Friday. Can't say CSK were clinical today, but their spin bowling surely 
was. Noor Ahmad is their latest weapon in that department; will it make MI think if they 
should have played Mujeeb tonight? 
11.06pm The crowd can't complain that they didn't get to see Dhoni bat, although they 
didn't see him score tonight, having waited for this day after a year. CSK start IPL 2025 
with a victory which looked a little nervy in the middle, but they were right on top when 
they kept MI to 155 with the help of their spinners. Remember, this means MI have not 
won their first match of an IPL season since 2012 now, a record that continues to haunt 
them. The players start to shake hands, one by one and here come Dhoni and Vignesh 
Puthur face to face. The 23-year-old can't believe he's shaking hands with this legend, 
he's just smiling ear to ear and not able to utter a word. Dhoni finally breaks the ice and 
gives him a few pats on the back, probably praising him for his fearless IPL debut today. 
Finally Puthur says something but Dhoni can't hear it because of the crowd and finally 
brings his ear close to the young guy to hear him. 
Noor Ahmad is the Player of the Match: Feels great to play around the world but special 
to play for CSK. Sometimes I thought they weren't picking me but I was focusing on my 
bowling. My favourite was Surya's wicket, Mahi bhai's stumping was so electric. It's 
great to have Mahi bhai behind the stumps. 
Ruturaj Gaikwad: Right after I got out (it might have been tense). There are matches 
that get close sometimes but happy to be on the winning side. Me batting at No. 3 is the 
requirement for the team, gives our new team balance and Rahul Tripathi can be 
aggressive at the top while I can play both sides of the game. Our spinners were right on 
the mark, we were really excited about them bowling in tandem at Chepauk after the 
auction. Khaleel has been doing well for the last 2-3 years, he's experienced. Noor is an 
X-factor and good to have him in the team. Dhoni is still the same, he's fitter this year 
and hitting more sixes in the nets this year. 
That's all we have from this El Clasico to wrap up the opening weekend of IPL 2025. 
First was the run-fest in Hyderabad, and then this low-scoring slightly tense game at 
Chepauk. MI have lots to do before the next weekend as they fly to Ahmedabad now, 
while CSK will be thrilled about their new recruits winning them the match tonight. Sid 
Monga's report is here already in case you had plans this Sunday and missed the action. 
And on that note, it's goodbye from me, Vishal Dikshit, and Ekanth. Join us again 
tomorrow, for DC vs LSG. Ciao ciao! If you're in India, I leave you all with this stunning 
Dhoni stumping from earlier today...
